request.purpose: We study regional differences in COPD among adults to plan respiratory care services with the regional health authorities.
request.question: How many adults have COPD in each region and what is the prevalence?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
COPD = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J44.
Prevalence = adults with COPD / all adults in the region × 100, one decimal.
Report per region: adults, adults with COPD and the prevalence.

request.purpose: Research on blood sugar control in type 2 diabetes, to compare care between hospitals.
request.question: What is the mean HbA1c of adults with type 2 diabetes, by hospital?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Use the latest HbA1c (LOINC 4548-4) per patient; patients without an HbA1c are left out.
Report per hospital: adults with type 2 diabetes who have an HbA1c value and their mean HbA1c, one decimal.

request.purpose: Health services research on hip fractures, to compare hospital workload and length of stay.
request.question: How many inpatient stays with a main diagnosis of hip fracture started in 2025, and how long did they last, by hospital?
definitions: Inpatient stay = encounter with type 'inpatient'.
Hip fracture stay = inpatient stay whose main diagnosis (primary_icd10) starts with S72.
Count stays (not patients) whose start_date is in 2025.
Length of stay = end_date minus start_date in days.
Report per hospital: hip fracture stays and mean length of stay, one decimal.

request.purpose: Guidelines recommend statins for most adults with type 2 diabetes. We want to know how large the treatment gap is, to plan a quality programme.
request.question: Among adults with type 2 diabetes, how many have no active statin, by age band?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Statin = ATC code starting with C10AA.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per age band: adults with type 2 diabetes, how many of them have no active statin and that share in %, one decimal.

request.purpose: We develop and validate a model that predicts the decline of kidney function in chronic kidney disease. The model needs individual-level histories; aggregated statistics are not sufficient.
request.question: Provide pseudonymised conditions, medications and eGFR values for adults with chronic kidney disease who have at least one eGFR value.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Chronic kidney disease = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with N18.
Cohort = adults with chronic kidney disease who have at least one eGFR value (LOINC 62238-1).
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.
